description: The dependency-update rules the templates and every project made from them share.

packageRules.description: Template updates reach projects within hours, each template layer in its own PR: the null groupName undoes group:allNonMajor. The note says when to apply an update's rulesets, which .github/rulesets/apply.sh explains.
prBodyNotes: When this update changes `.github/rulesets/`, apply the rulesets right before you merge it, with no PR into `staging` or `main` open: check out this PR's branch, run `make rulesets`, then merge.
